svg.title: K-nucleotide optimization history with direct best-fit exponentials
svg.desc: A linear main plot shows the exponential initial decline. A magnified log-scale inset shows the later trajectory continuing below the fitted offset.
svg.text: K-nucleotide: exponential fits to the measured runtimes
125 million bases · complete-process timings · elapsed hours from the initial ≈218× checkpoint
Direct fit with a free offset
Elapsed hours since the first completed full-input run
DIRECT LEAST SQUARES IN RUNTIME RATIOS
With offset: R² = 0.9990 · without offset: R² = 0.9935
Early values dominate this score; the later results keep improving.
Same data from hour 3 onward · magnified log scale
4 Move error work off the hot path
Both curves minimize squared errors in the original ratios; the starting point and the offset are not fixed. Curves stop at the last observation.
All 118 cohorts and 708 process observations remain, including negative trials. Drop labels compare each change with its contemporaneous parent.
The first three highlighted checkpoints are single runs. The ≈218× checkpoint is 216.1647× in its retained receipt. Elapsed hours include all gaps.
The fitted offset is not a floor or a forecast: the tail inset shows the later data continuing below it. Each cohort uses its own Rust median.
